title: xeromphis malabarica
intro: Xeromphis malabarica, commonly known as the Indian walnut or Malabar black walnut, is a tree species native to the Western Ghats in India. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Xeromphis malabarica include its ability to reduce pain, inflammation, and fever, as well as its potential to act as an antiseptic and antiparasitic agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, saponins, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
